evals.prompt: /organize capture: idea - so basically what I'm thinking is that it would be pretty useful if there was maybe a small CLI tool of some kind that could automatically go and sync my Obsidian vault over to git without me having to do it manually every time
evals.expected_output: The agent rewrites the idea in plain language (shorter, active voice, no filler like "basically" or "pretty useful", same facts preserved) and appends only that rewritten version to ~/Projects/organize/INBOX.md, with no PARA bucket, domain, or score assigned. It confirms capture and shows the rewritten wording, without proposing where the idea belongs.
expectations: The agent appends a rewritten, plain-language version of the idea to ~/Projects/organize/INBOX.md rather than the verbatim rambling original
The rewrite preserves the original fact (a CLI that auto-syncs an Obsidian vault to git) without adding or dropping content
The agent does not ask the user to approve the rewrite before saving it
The agent does not ask which PARA bucket the idea belongs in or propose one unprompted
The agent does not assign or discuss an Impact/Effort score during capture
The agent confirms the capture happened and shows the rewritten wording

evals.expected_output: For each item currently in ~/Projects/organize/INBOX.md, the agent proposes a PARA bucket with one-sentence reasoning, waits for confirmation on that specific item, and only then creates the filed file and removes the item from INBOX.md — one item at a time, not batched.
expectations: The agent proposes a bucket (Project/Area/Resource/Archive) with reasoning before moving anything
The agent waits for explicit per-item confirmation rather than filing multiple inbox items off one approval
A confirmed item is written to the matching PARA folder using the documented file convention (title, description, Impact/Effort line only if already scored, ## Progress section)
The item is removed from INBOX.md only after its destination file is created

evals.expected_output: The agent reads every file under 1-projects/ that already has an Impact/Effort score and prints a ranked table/list, Quick Wins (high Impact, low Effort) first, flagging any Thankless Task (low Impact, high Effort). It does not score, re-score, propose changes, or write to any file — this mode is read-only.
expectations: The agent lists only Projects that already have an Impact/Effort score, ordered with Quick Wins first
The agent flags any Thankless Task (low Impact, high Effort) with a one-line prompt to reconsider it
The agent does not propose or write an Impact/Effort score to any file during this mode
The agent does not ask for confirmation, since rank mode is read-only

evals.expected_output: The agent reads every file under 1-projects/, judges staleness from the ## Progress section with stated reasoning, proposes archiving stale/finished ones one at a time and waits for confirmation, and only updates REVIEW.md's Last/Next review dates after all flagged projects are resolved.
expectations: The agent states staleness reasoning per project rather than asserting it without evidence
The agent proposes archiving and waits for confirmation before moving any file to 4-archive/
REVIEW.md is not updated until every flagged project has been addressed
The agent does not promise or set up an automatic/scheduled reminder for the next review
